faq.pageSubtitle: Essential guidance for contestants signing in, viewing contests, and submitting work.
faq.adminPageSubtitle: Administrator workflows for accounts, contests, teams, submissions, and data.
faq.q1: What should I do first after receiving an account?
faq.a1: Click Sign in in the top-right corner, enter the username/password issued by the organizers, then check Profile and My Contests to confirm your assigned team.
faq.q2: Where do I submit my work?
faq.a2: Go to Profile → My Contests. When a submission stage is open, the submission form appears in the correct contest. The page also shows the current stage, remaining time, and prompt if one has been added.
faq.q3: Can I edit a submitted file?
faq.a3: Yes. As long as the submission stage is still open, you can replace or delete the current submission and upload again. Once the stage ends, the system blocks further changes.
faq.q4: How do I know how much time is left?
faq.a4: In My Contests, each active contest shows the current stage and a live countdown to the stage end time, including seconds.
faq.q5: Where can I view the prompt?
faq.a5: If organizers have added a prompt for the submission stage, it appears in My Contests. Links inside the prompt are clickable.
faq.q6: Can I edit my personal information?
faq.a6: No. Contestant accounts are managed by the organizers, so personal information is read-only. If something is incorrect, contact the organizers.
faq.a7: Active means the contest is published and may have open stages. Closed means the contest has ended. Cancelled means it was cancelled. Draft is for organizers only and is not public.
faq.q8: How do I contact the organizers?
faq.a8: Hotline: 0353 840 125 - Phan Minh Trang (Head Organizer). Email: contact.toanmohinh@gmail.com. Instagram: archive.toanmohinh. Facebook: Toán Mô hình Hà Nội.
faq.q9: Where can I view contests I joined?
faq.a9: Go to Profile → My Contests to see all assigned contests, team info, members, current stage, and latest submission.
faq.aq1: How do I create a contest?
faq.aa1: Go to Contest Management and click New contest. Fill in title, slug, description, rules, cover image, participation type, min/max team size, time window, and stages. Set the status to Active when ready to publish.
faq.aq2: How do I add stages and prompts?
faq.aa2: In the contest form, scroll to Stages and click Add stage. Each stage needs a name, start/end times inside the contest window, submission options, and optional prompt text for contestants.
faq.aq3: How do I create a team?
faq.aa3: In Contest Management, open Registrations for a contest. Enter TEAM_CODE, team name, level, leader, and members, then save. The system validates team size against the contest min/max settings.
faq.aq4: How do I view team submissions?
faq.aa4: In the team management panel, expand any registration row to see all submissions. Click the Download button next to a file to download it via a 5-minute signed URL.
faq.aa5: Contestants can always replace submitted work while the submission stage is open. After the stage ends, both API and UI block new uploads and replacements.
faq.aq6: How do I use the Bucket (file storage)?
faq.aa6: Go to Bucket in the navigation. You can browse the folder tree, create folders, upload, rename, delete, and copy URLs for files in post-images and submissions.
faq.aa7: Go to Account Management to create accounts, update profiles, change roles, and reset passwords. Usernames must be at least 6 letters/numbers/underscores; passwords must be at least 8 characters with no spaces.
faq.aq8: How do I manage posts, tags, and data?
faq.aa8: Go to Admin Workspace to create, edit, publish, or delete posts and tags. The Database section at the bottom provides read-only tables for quick review.
